verdict.rationale: Codegen supports Slack-based notifications and agent interaction (docs-2, docs-9), which could technically be used from a phone via the Slack app, but there is no explicit mobile app, push-approval workflow, or documented 'approve on the go' feature for key agent decisions. missing for 10: dedicated mobile/approval UI, evidence of approving specific agent decisions (e.g., merge/deploy gates) from a phone, and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
